mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.task_name: Ingest and Parse RFP Document into Structured Data
units.description: Read the uploaded government cloud migration RFP (PDF/Word), extract all textual content, and convert it into a structured tabular format (e.g., sections, subsections, key phrases). Store the parsed data in JSON for downstream tasks.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: JSON representation of RFP structure with section titles and paragraph text.

units.description: Analyze the parsed RFP JSON to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Compile these into a list with associated section references and any required evidence or documentation.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: Table of mandatory compliance criteria with source references.

units.description: Using the compliance list and typical cloud migration labor roles (e.g., Cloud Architect, Security Engineer, Project Manager), create a tiered pricing model (e.g., Standard, Premium, Enterprise). Include hourly rates, estimated effort per compliance item, and total cost projections.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: Pricing matrix with roles, tiers, hours, rates, and subtotal/total costs.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Compliance Traceability Matrix
units.description: Synthesize a polished executive proposal document that includes an executive summary, solution overview, compliance traceability matrix linking each RFP requirement to our proposed controls and pricing, and a clear call‑to‑action. Format the output as a structured JSON or Markdown suitable for conversion to PDF.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2, t3]
units.output_contract: Complete proposal text with embedded compliance traceability table and pricing summary.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes mandatory technical compliance criteria extraction, multi‑tier labor pricing modeling, and a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The request requires ingesting an uploaded document, extracting structured requirements, performing quantitative modeling of labor costs, and synthesizing a final proposal with traceability. This maps to four distinct phases: ingestion & parsing, requirement extraction, cost modeling, and proposal generation.
